status: reference-led interaction board; wireframes only; not visual approval

map.title: Navigation / conditions
map.detail: Geographic minimap on a planet. Switch the same region to climate and ecosystem slots. Replace it with travel filters at galaxy scale. Our circular local radar does not fulfill this.

comm.title: Contact
comm.detail: Portrait or call cue identifies the actual local speaker and relationship. Opening it leads to character dialogue, commerce and ship services. A generic Contact link is insufficient.

palette.title: Category → item palette
palette.detail: Anchor beside the ship. Select a category, then an item, then a world target where required. Counts belong on consumables; cooldowns and selection belong on their slots. Collapse without moving ship status.

ship.title: Ship status
ship.detail: Recognizable ship representation; readable health and energy remain stable when palettes change. Clicking ship opens equipment details. No permanent recharge or mystery-toggle buttons.

world.title: World and target
world.detail: Leave most of the display for flying, targets and visible effects. Brief target-local feedback replaces the detached center console. A screen of controls must not replace the act of flying.

objective.title: Current objective / notice
objective.detail: Short optional guidance. Explain a new capability when acquired. Important warnings should identify origin and action without producing repeated chores.

status.title: Marks and progression only
status.detail: If a slim progression strip is retained, it contains game state only. Options, save/load, audio and controls open through Escape. This is an explicit user difference from the original footer.

dialog.title: Character dialogue
dialog.detail: Dedicated portrait, nation, relationship reasons, speech and replies. Repair/refuel/trade are contextual services. This is a composition requirement, not an implemented diplomatic scene.

store.title: Shop inventory
store.detail: Pictorial items, prices, provider stock, unlock state and purchase quantity. Keep item selection distinct from a purchase. The existing two-product dock list is not shop parity.

collection.title: Badge case / collections
collection.detail: Filter by rank or activity. Medallions communicate earned levels, progress and locked state. Selecting a badge explains its next tier and shop unlocks.

menu.title: Escape menu
menu.detail: Resume, save/load, settings, history and title. Opening pauses the game; nested settings return here. Closing preserves a pre-existing explicit pause.

states.title: Surface flight
states.observation: Map and communications occupy the left; tools and ship occupy the right.
states.required: Keep a clear flight area; join tools to ship status and replace the local radar with geographic navigation.
states.gap: User rejected icon ornament, typography and planet appearance. Rounded/metallic wells and persistent above-palette captions are removed; temporary glyphs and hover help remain.

states.title: Expanded tools
states.observation: Tool bins distinguish shortcut numbers from consumable charges.
states.required: Provide expandable palettes, item-local costs and contextual targeting. Browsing must not spend energy or fire.
states.gap: Shared selection, category-relative slots, two rows and paging work. Dense layout is fixture-tested; the actual equipment catalog is still small.

states.title: Inventory / packs
states.observation: Transaction items carry their own quantities; trade controls sit outside the item grid.
states.required: Use an owned pack directly from an inventory item. Separate consumables, installed equipment and physical cargo.
states.gap: Owned packs work in a live quick palette and paused detail drawer. Sample cradles do not yet represent a complete hold or commodity catalog.

states.title: Planet conditions
states.observation: The planet instrument toggles between map and terraforming information.
states.required: Place atmosphere, temperature, habitability and ecosystem requirements together. Selecting a condition should explain the limiting factor.
states.gap: A local warm-bed mechanic is not planet terraforming or ecological-tier parity.

states.title: Communications
states.observation: An alien portrait, dialogue and choices form a distinct encounter screen.
states.required: Speaker identity, relationship and purpose precede actions. Ship services remain here, with the actual quote.
states.gap: One static nursery contact and ad hoc service rings; no contextual nation or expressive performance.

states.title: Shop / trade
states.observation: An eight-column item grid shows prices, quantities and dim entries.
states.required: Show badge eligibility, prerequisites, price, quantity and stock before purchase. Sell from real ship cargo.
states.gap: No full shop, badge-gated goods or buy/sell quantity interface.

states.title: System view
states.observation: Planets, star and orbits replace the close planetary scene.
states.required: Pull back into the same system; select a planet for travel and local contact. Preserve ship state. No local terrain chart in this view; use the system/galaxy navigation itself.
states.gap: The personal-flight prototype has only Morrow; the strategic scene uses separate state.

states.title: Galaxy view
states.observation: The starmap exposes range, routes and filters.
states.required: Show unknown versus visited systems, reachable hops and costs. Keep inventory and ship state continuous. No local terrain chart in this view; use the system/galaxy navigation itself.
states.gap: Strategic graph exists, but personal flight cannot travel through it.

states.title: Badges / unlocks
states.observation: Medallions combine earned stars, progress strips and undiscovered silhouettes.
states.required: Show requirements and alternate paths. Earning a tier unlocks a purchasable capability, not a free item.
states.gap: Separate strategic ranks and local history; no shared badge case or unlock ledger.

states.title: Escape menu
states.observation: EA documents Escape as contextual dismissal, deselection or options access.
states.required: User override: Escape opens utilities during flight; close current inspection first. Keep utility buttons off the HUD.
states.gap: Functional correction exists; menu art and native review remain unfinished.
